- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To integrate the given frontend with the provided backend code on a WordPress website page, follow these steps: Create a new WordPress page or edit an existing one, copy HTML code into the HTML editor, copy CSS code into the CSS editor, copy JavaScript code into a new JavaScript file named 'paraphrase.js', upload 'paraphrase.js' to 'wp-content/themes/your-theme/js/' folder, enqueue 'paraphrase.js' in the functions.php file, update the apiUrl variable in 'paraphrase.js' to the URL of the PHP script, and preview the WordPress page.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The code to enqueue the 'paraphrase.js' file in the functions.php file is:
```php
function add_paraphrase_script() {
    wp_enqueue_script( 'paraphrase-script', get_template_directory_uri() . '/js/paraphrase.js', array(), '1.0.0', true );
}
add_action( 'wp_enqueue_scripts', 'add_paraphrase_script' );
```
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The apiUrl variable in 'paraphrase.js' should be updated to:
```javascript
const apiUrl = 'http://example.com/paraphrase.php';
```
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Note: Ensure that the WordPress website's server has the necessary dependencies and libraries installed to support the backend code's requirements.
- [USER] How can I install these libraries in WordPress? Here are the libraries: TensorFlow and Hugging Face Transformers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To install TensorFlow and Hugging Face Transformers libraries in WordPress, access the server via SSH or FTP, navigate to the WordPress root directory, and add the line `define('FS_METHOD', 'direct');` to wp-config.php.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Create a new directory named "libraries", download TensorFlow and Hugging Face Transformers libraries, unzip the files, and copy the folders to the "libraries" directory.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Update your PHP code to include the libraries with:
```php
require_once(ABSPATH . 'libraries/tensorflow/autoload.php');
require_once(ABSPATH . 'libraries/transformers/autoload.php');
```
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Save your PHP file and upload it to your WordPress server to use the libraries.
